intro: Some matters involve modest sums but carry consequences if ignored — effects on licences, insurance rates, even immigration status. These are usually straightforward to handle; the important thing is not to miss the response deadline. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
